scope: SYNTHETIC_ONLY; never read actual card truth, root seeds or private labels

shared_master_blind.selection: SystemRandom.sample within each frozen domain; opaque shuffled world ids
shared_master_blind.fingerprint: exact official six-decimal footprint CSV; candidate sets retained
shared_master_blind.predict: official weather.slots, events, earthquake effects, stress and request outputs, all future rows after first public slot
shared_master_blind.solver_input: synthetic public footprint/targets/calendar plus full synthetic nonseed generator config
shared_master_blind.holdout: no fitted parameters, no labels used by solver, predictions frozen before evaluator opens synthetic labels
shared_master_blind.negative_expected: no candidate; abstain instead of guessing

counterexample.build_path: build_spec_bundle, same catalog seed=7, independent weather seeds
counterexample.quality: constant fields and efficiency, Gaussian draws still consumed; only hidden background closure differs
counterexample.pair_selection: lexicographically first pair with first 4 slots open and identical, first differing openness at index 4..11; preserve all candidate status
counterexample.action: one official 60 second one-fiber exposure per prefix slot plus public waits, target chosen by highest public geometric altitude
counterexample.proof_gate: all public/config bytes equal, all snapshots before divergent action equal, at least four positive score feedbacks equal, next action score differs

stopping: no actual seed search, no GPU, no full season, no global bounds; stop after blind and two-world existence proof
